nodes.body: Pre-clearing Immunostaining (MAP2 labeling before organic solvent steps)**
nodes.source_quote: **101 Pre-clearing Immunostaining (MAP2 labeling before organic solvent steps)**

nodes.body: Wash fixed 3 mm brain blocks (post-fixed in 4% PFA) 3× with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min per wash)
nodes.source_quote: 101.1 Wash fixed 3 mm brain blocks (post-fixed in 4% PFA) 3× with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min per wash)

nodes.body: Permeabilization and blocking: incubate tissue in blocking/permeabilization buffer [0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours, with gentle shaking)
nodes.source_quote: 101.2 Permeabilization and blocking: incubate tissue in blocking/permeabilization buffer [0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours, with gentle shaking)

nodes.body: Primary antibody incubation: incubate with anti-MAP2 rabbit polyclonal antibody [1:500 dilution in antibody diluent: 0.5% Triton X-100, 5% normal donkey serum, 0.1% sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle shaking)
nodes.source_quote: 101.3 Primary antibody incubation: incubate with anti-MAP2 rabbit polyclonal antibody [1:500 dilution in antibody diluent: 0.5% Triton X-100, 5% normal donkey serum, 0.1% sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle shaking)

nodes.body: Wash 5× with 1× PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
nodes.source_quote: 101.4 Wash 5× with 1× PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

nodes.body: Secondary antibody incubation: incubate with donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody [1:500 dilution in antibody diluent as in step 101.3]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle shaking, protected from light)
nodes.source_quote: 101.5 Secondary antibody incubation: incubate with donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody [1:500 dilution in antibody diluent as in step 101.3]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle shaking, protected from light)

nodes.body: Wash 5× with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
nodes.source_quote: 101.6 Wash 5× with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

nodes.body: Post-immunostaining fixation: incubate in 4% (wt/vol) PFA in 1× PBS to crosslink antibodies in place. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, with gentle shaking)
nodes.source_quote: 101.7 Post-immunostaining fixation: incubate in 4% (wt/vol) PFA in 1× PBS to crosslink antibodies in place. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, with gentle shaking)

nodes.body: Wash 3× with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min per wash)
nodes.source_quote: 101.8 Wash 3× with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min per wash)

nodes.body: Dehydration (FDISCO — all steps at 4 °C, protected from light)**
nodes.source_quote: **102 Dehydration (FDISCO — all steps at 4 °C, protected from light)**

nodes.body: Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in ddH₂O (freshly prepared, stabilizer-free THF). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)
nodes.source_quote: 102.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in ddH₂O (freshly prepared, stabilizer-free THF). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

nodes.body: Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)
nodes.source_quote: 102.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

nodes.body: Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)
nodes.source_quote: 102.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

nodes.body: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)
nodes.source_quote: 102.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

nodes.body: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (anhydrous). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)
nodes.source_quote: 102.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (anhydrous). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

nodes.body: Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) THF (anhydrous). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)
nodes.source_quote: 102.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) THF (anhydrous). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

nodes.body: Delipidation and Clearing**
nodes.source_quote: **103 Delipidation and Clearing**

nodes.body: Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, 100%, anhydrous) for delipidation. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 30 min, with gentle shaking; use glass vials, fume hood)
nodes.source_quote: 103.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, 100%, anhydrous) for delipidation. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 30 min, with gentle shaking; use glass vials, fume hood)

nodes.body: Remove DCM completely by aspiration; do not allow tissue to dry.
nodes.source_quote: 103.2 Remove DCM completely by aspiration; do not allow tissue to dry.

nodes.body: Refractive Index Matching and Clearing in DBE**
nodes.source_quote: **104 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing in DBE**

nodes.body: Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, 100%, Sigma-Aldrich 108014) — first exchange. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours, with gentle shaking, protected from light)
nodes.source_quote: 104.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, 100%, Sigma-Aldrich 108014) — first exchange. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours, with gentle shaking, protected from light)

nodes.body: Incubation with fresh DBE (100%) — second exchange until tissue is fully transparent. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4–6 hours or overnight, with gentle shaking, protected from light)
nodes.source_quote: 104.2 Incubation with fresh DBE (100%) — second exchange until tissue is fully transparent. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4–6 hours or overnight, with gentle shaking, protected from light)

nodes.body: Verify optical transparency visually; tissue should appear fully clear. If residual opacity remains, replace with fresh DBE and continue incubation for an additional 4 hours at 4 °C.
nodes.source_quote: 104.3 Verify optical transparency visually; tissue should appear fully clear. If residual opacity remains, replace with fresh DBE and continue incubation for an additional 4 hours at 4 °C.

nodes.body: Long-term Storage**
nodes.source_quote: **105 Long-term Storage**

nodes.body: Transfer cleared tissue to a sealed glass vial filled with fresh 100% DBE (RI = 1.56). Ensure complete submersion and absence of air bubbles. (Temperature: 4 °C, protected from light, Time: up to 6 months)
nodes.source_quote: 105.1 Transfer cleared tissue to a sealed glass vial filled with fresh 100% DBE (RI = 1.56). Ensure complete submersion and absence of air bubbles. (Temperature: 4 °C, protected from light, Time: up to 6 months)

nodes.body: Label vials with sample ID, clearing date, and antibody/fluorophore information. Store upright in a light-tight container at 4 °C.
nodes.source_quote: 105.2 Label vials with sample ID, clearing date, and antibody/fluorophore information. Store upright in a light-tight container at 4 °C.

nodes.body: Inspect samples every 4–6 weeks for clarity and potential DBE evaporation; replenish DBE if volume decreases.
nodes.source_quote: 105.3 Inspect samples every 4–6 weeks for clarity and potential DBE evaporation; replenish DBE if volume decreases.

nodes.body: Pre-imaging Preparation (at time of imaging, including after long-term storage)**
nodes.source_quote: **106 Pre-imaging Preparation (at time of imaging, including after long-term storage)**

nodes.body: Remove sample from storage DBE; transfer to a fresh glass vial with 100% DBE for equilibration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min, protected from light)
nodes.source_quote: 106.1 Remove sample from storage DBE; transfer to a fresh glass vial with 100% DBE for equilibration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min, protected from light)

nodes.body: Mount sample in a custom imaging chamber (e.g., FEP tube or glass-bottom dish) filled with 100% DBE (RI = 1.56) compatible with the objective immersion medium.
nodes.source_quote: 106.2 Mount sample in a custom imaging chamber (e.g., FEP tube or glass-bottom dish) filled with 100% DBE (RI = 1.56) compatible with the objective immersion medium.

nodes.body: For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM): use a long-working-distance objective corrected for RI = 1.56 (e.g., CLARITY/CUBIC-compatible objective or a custom-dipping objective with DBE-compatible immersion). Imaging channels: 488 nm excitation / 510–540 nm emission (EGFP, sparse reporter neurons); 633/647 nm excitation / 660–720 nm emission (Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2 dendritic counterstain).
nodes.source_quote: 106.3 For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM): use a long-working-distance objective corrected for RI = 1.56 (e.g., CLARITY/CUBIC-compatible objective or a custom-dipping objective with DBE-compatible immersion). Imaging channels: 488 nm excitation / 510–540 nm emission (EGFP, sparse reporter neurons); 633/647 nm excitation / 660–720 nm emission (Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2 dendritic counterstain).

nodes.body: For confocal imaging: use an oil-immersion or RI-matched objective; apply a coverslip with DBE as mounting medium and seal edges with two-component epoxy to prevent evaporation during long imaging sessions.
nodes.source_quote: 106.4 For confocal imaging: use an oil-immersion or RI-matched objective; apply a coverslip with DBE as mounting medium and seal edges with two-component epoxy to prevent evaporation during long imaging sessions.

nodes.body: After imaging, return sample to sealed glass vial with fresh DBE for continued storage at 4 °C if repeat imaging is planned. (Temperature: 4 °C, protected from light)
nodes.source_quote: 106.5 After imaging, return sample to sealed glass vial with fresh DBE for continued storage at 4 °C if repeat imaging is planned. (Temperature: 4 °C, protected from light)
